description: Example webhook payloads for a simulated API monitoring workflow. Use test endpoints only.

sample_inputs.Description: Monitoring run to test server-error retry handling
Monitoring run to test authentication-failure classification

expected_behavior: HTTP 200 is classified as success and logged.
HTTP 401 is classified as an authentication failure and should not trigger the temporary-server-error retry branch.
HTTP 400 is classified as a bad request and should not trigger the temporary-server-error retry branch.
HTTP 503 follows the bounded retry path; after the final attempt, the final status is logged and an alert is sent.
notes: The exported blueprint is configured to use the HTTP 200 test endpoint by default.
For demonstrations, change all four HTTP module URLs to the same test status endpoint, run one test, then restore all four to /status/200.
This is a portfolio demonstration using httpbin.org, not a production monitoring service.
Configure your own Make.com webhook, Google Sheets connection, Gmail connection, and alert recipient after importing the blueprint.
